spanish: Y me citaré a ti allí, y hablaré contigo desde sobre la kappóret, desde entre los dos querubines que sobre arca del testimonio, todo lo que mandaré a ti a hijos de Israel.

findings.issue: Common noun (definite feminine singular) left as the untranslated Hebraized form kappóret; non-name lemmas stay Spanish.
Niphal sequential 1cs is rendered with pronominal citarse; me citaré can be heard as quote/summon myself rather than meet by appointment, though the 1cs subject and לְךָ goal stay intact.
lo in todo lo que is unmarked grammatical smoothing with no separate token; it does not add a concept beyond all-that.

notes: Place, two cherubim, ark of the testimony, and the command to you toward the sons of Israel match the remaining tokens.
